_why: Places: the folders whose CONTENTS change (product refs, render outputs, ready-to-post drafts), described from what is on disk by crew/lib/krew_places.py into map_file (one section per folder: path, files, its README.md/SOURCES.md). Index map_file's folder as the docs source `places` (krew.yaml docs.sources: places: ~/.krew/places) so krew_docs answers 'where is X' for a folder made yesterday. krew-places-watch rewrites the map and rebuilds that source seconds after a drop. Paths here are examples: point them at your own folders.

places.name: reference photos
places.what: Krew-only reference images of the user's own gear and products, one folder per model with a SOURCES.md saying where each image came from. Look here before rendering or describing a product he owns.
places.rule: REFERENCE ONLY: use them to check a prompt's shape, colour and details. Never a render's first frame, never an output, never in the public repo or a pack (third-party photos).

places.name: render order outputs
places.what: What each render order made (stills, clips), one folder per order id. Orders are filed with scripts/render-orders.py add and drained in the render window by scripts/heavy-render.py; the order file (pending/running/done/failed) names its card and prompt.
places.rule: A render is a draft until the user approves it; approved marketing goes to ready-to-post.

places.name: ready to post
places.what: Marketing drafts ready for the user to post himself, by channel (x, google-ads) and day. The team_outbox writes here.
places.rule: Nothing here is posted by the house; the user posts it.

watch._why: crew/scripts/krew-places-watch.py (krew-places-watch.service): inotify on every place root and its subfolders; a burst of drops settles into ONE map rewrite + `docs_index.py build --source places`. A .path unit cannot do this: PathChanged watches one directory's own entries, never its subfolders.
